description: Shared harness gates. Review and trust these hooks in the Codex runtime before use.

hooks.commandWindows: [Console]::OutputEncoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; python -X utf8 (Join-Path (git rev-parse --show-toplevel) 'kernel/hook.py') --agent codex --event PreToolUse; exit $LASTEXITCODE
hooks.statusMessage: Isolation gate (edit guard, worktree naming, exit verify)

hooks.commandWindows: [Console]::OutputEncoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; python -X utf8 (Join-Path (git rev-parse --show-toplevel) 'kernel/hook.py') --agent codex --event PostToolUse; exit $LASTEXITCODE
[Console]::OutputEncoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; python -X utf8 (Join-Path (git rev-parse --show-toplevel) 'kernel/hook.py') --agent codex --event Stop; exit $LASTEXITCODE
